description: Post a message on the matter thread to the awarded vendor. Use when the user wants to answer a vendor's question, relay an instruction, or send an update. The thread is the record: the vendor is emailed a doorbell notification that links back to the thread, and every message lands on the append-only audit trail. Never promise the vendor was called or texted - this posts to the thread and emails the doorbell. Requires SCOPE_API_TOKEN.

body.description: The message text, relayed verbatim from the user.

matter_id.description: Matter display id (SC-2041), UUID, or slug.

name: scope_send_message
